pins.name: D7
pins.label: D7 (GPIO7)
pins.notes: E0 TMC2209 stepper driver DIAG (stall-detect/diagnostic) output - dedicated 3D-printer motion-control hardware, not general purpose. Was previously exposed as plain D7 due to a static-const alias in pins_arduino.h; corrected here.

pins.name: D11
pins.label: D11 (GPIO11)
pins.notes: BLTouch/3D-touch probe control (servo) line, confirmed via vendor MKS_THR.cfg - dedicated, not general purpose. Was previously exposed as plain D11; corrected here.

pins.name: D12
pins.label: D12 (GPIO12)
pins.notes: Onboard ADXL345 accelerometer SPI1 MISO - dedicated input-shaper sensor hardware, not general purpose. Was previously exposed as plain D12; corrected here.

pins.name: D13
pins.label: D13 (GPIO13)
pins.notes: Onboard ADXL345 accelerometer SPI1 chip-select (CS) - dedicated, not general purpose. Was previously exposed as plain D13; corrected here.

pins.name: D14
pins.label: D14 (GPIO14)
pins.notes: Onboard ADXL345 accelerometer SPI1 clock (SCK) - dedicated, not general purpose. Was previously exposed as plain D14; corrected here.

pins.name: D15
pins.label: D15 (GPIO15)
pins.notes: Onboard ADXL345 accelerometer SPI1 MOSI - dedicated, not general purpose. Was previously exposed as plain D15; corrected here.

pins.name: D20
pins.label: GPIO20 (Led Neopixel)
pins.notes: Onboard WS2812-style status NeoPixel data line, confirmed via vendor MKS_THR.cfg and README - tagged led_neopixel per this repo's bigtreetech_SKR_Pico precedent.

pins.name: D21
pins.label: D21 (GPIO21)
pins.notes: Probe/BLTouch sensor (trigger) signal, confirmed via vendor MKS_THR.cfg - dedicated, not general purpose. Was previously exposed as plain D21; corrected here.

pins.name: D24
pins.label: D24 (GPIO24)
pins.notes: X endstop input, confirmed via vendor MKS_THR.cfg (endstop_pin gpio24) - dedicated, not general purpose despite the generic 'IO24' name in pins_arduino.h. Was previously exposed as plain D24; corrected here.

pins.name: D25
pins.label: D25 (GPIO25)
pins.notes: Y endstop input, confirmed via vendor MKS_THR.cfg (endstop_pin gpio25) - dedicated, not general purpose despite the generic 'IO25' name in pins_arduino.h. Was previously exposed as plain D25; corrected here.

pins.name: D29/A3
pins.label: D29/A3 (GPIO29)
pins.notes: Filament-runout sensor input connector, confirmed via community Klipper configs (filament_switch_sensor switch_pin gpio29 for this exact board) - dedicated, not general purpose. Was previously exposed as plain D29/A3; corrected here.
